_comment_testRunner: The tap runner executes each test file directly (node <file>), which keeps it in the same process as Stryker coverage hook. Running them via `node --test` forks a child per file, the hook records nothing, and every mutant reports NoCoverage.
_comment_mutate: Only code that tests/unit can meaningfully kill. tests/repo is excluded from the runner because it reads the real source tree, which a mutation sandbox deliberately alters, so anything mutated here must have a unit-level test.
_comment_incremental: Incremental mode is off: a full run takes about half a minute with per-test analysis, so the complexity and the risk of a stale incremental report are not worth it.
_comment_thresholds: Measured 95.0-95.1% on 2026-09-05. break sits a few points below so an ordinary change cannot fail on noise, while a real drop in test strength does; the score varies a little because a timed-out mutant counts as killed. Ratchet it up as the score improves.
